# Riverbend Nonprofit Network theory of change: interventions

As of 2026-09-30.

| Intervention | Owner | Status | Targets | Pathway status of the targets |
|--------------|-------|--------|---------|-------------------------------|
| Run mixed-size peer-learning cohorts (`int-peer-cohorts`) | Riverbend Nonprofit Network | In progress | Peer-learning cohorts and coaching sessions delivered; Members form peer relationships across sizes | On track; On track |
| Offer one-to-one leadership coaching (`int-leader-coaching`) | Riverbend Nonprofit Network | In progress | Peer-learning cohorts and coaching sessions delivered; Leaders gain coaching-based skills and confidence | On track; On track |
| Deliver a management skills training series (`int-training-series`) _(inferred)_ | Northfield Learning Studio | Planned | Leaders gain coaching-based skills and confidence | On track |
| Run pooled bookkeeping and payroll help (`int-pooled-backoffice`) | Riverbend Nonprofit Network | In progress | Pooled service contracts and group purchasing deals in place; Members use pooled back-office services | Not started; Not started |
| Negotiate group purchasing agreements (`int-group-purchasing`) | Riverbend Nonprofit Network | In progress | Pooled service contracts and group purchasing deals in place | Not started |
| Maintain a shared grants calendar (`int-grants-calendar`) | Riverbend Nonprofit Network | Completed | Shared grants calendar published and kept current; Members consult the shared grants calendar when planning | Not started; Not started |
| Publish plain-language policy briefings (`int-policy-briefings`) _(hypothesis)_ | Riverbend Nonprofit Network | Planned | Policy briefings and joint-position drafts produced; Members understand local policy and funding processes | Not started; At risk |
| Convene member forums to draft joint positions (`int-joint-forums`) | Riverbend Nonprofit Network | In progress | Members understand local policy and funding processes; Members adopt and share joint positions on local issues | At risk; At risk |
| Set up a standing liaison channel with the county planning office (`int-liaison-channel`) | Riverbend County Office of Community Planning | In progress | A standing channel exists between members and the county planning office | Unmeasured |
| Host a funder and member roundtable (`int-funder-roundtable`) | Lowland Regional Fund | Planned | A standing channel exists between members and the county planning office; Local officials and funders engage members in planning | Unmeasured; At risk |
